consumer: The craft-here salvage objective's requirement check, asking 'does the reachable crafting inventory hold >=20 scrap?'
scope: The full crafting reach (on-person PLUS nearby map tiles, adjacent furniture/vehicles within reach), i.e. the crafting_inventory scope, not just the character's own inventory
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<Character>::amount_of, which tallies ONLY the Character's own items (plus bionic pseudo-tool special cases) via amount_of_internal, with no nearby/map reach
divergence: Avatar carries 0 scrap but 20 scrap sit on an adjacent tile within crafting reach: the craft-here objective should report 'enough' (engine crafting inventory counts the nearby scrap) but visitable<Character>::amount_of returns 0, so the proposal falsely reports 'not enough'
